question: Where can I get a list of wind projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

answer.summary: Start with EIA-860M. Its September 2026 Planned sheet had 77 wind generator rows across 71 plants. Only 17 generator rows carried code L (regulatory approvals pending). The file includes capacity, coordinates and planned operation dates. Check the actual permitting stage and date in the relevant agency files, such as BLM, BOEM or New York ORES.
main_caveats: EIA-860M only lists generators reported to or researched by EIA; early-stage and unreported projects can be absent, and capacities are 'preliminary' and silently revised.
EIA status (L, T, P, U, V, TS) is not a permit record: Heritage Wind (NY) shows 'P regulatory approvals not initiated' at 126 MW while ORES lists a permit for 184.8 MW.
BLM 'Completed - Completed' means the NEPA process ended, not that a project stands approved: Lava Ridge has ROD 12/4/2024 and a later DOI statement on cancelling it.
BLM, BOEM and ORES each cover only their jurisdiction (federal land, outer continental shelf, one state); wind on private land with no federal or state siting nexus is not in them.
Queue entries, leases and lease areas (BOEM lease layer: 4,892 block polygons) are leads, not authorisations.
answer.confidence_reason: EIA and BOEM data downloaded/queried; BLM and ORES read from pages and a portal endpoint. Only four jurisdictions checked; other states and the FAST-41 dashboard were not readable.

attributes.note: EIA planned wind rows all carry lat/long (77/77, plant point); BOEM gives lease/phase polygons; BLM a project point on some rows (15 of 32 wind-named).
EIA nameplate MW per generator row (sum by plant); BOEM/BLM/ORES give MW only in project text and it can differ (Revolution Wind 704 vs 715).
BLM 'Applicant', BOEM DEVELOPER_NAME and ORES text name the applicant; EIA gives only 'Entity Name' (owner/operator entity), not a developer field.
attributes.gap_note: EIA-860M has no developer field; only agency records name the applicant, project by project.

attributes.note: EIA has a survey code per generator. Code L flags pending approvals. Verify the stage, date and scope in the relevant BLM, BOEM or state records.
attributes.gap_note: Other state siting bodies and county permits were not opened (CA, TX, WY, IL, MN, etc.); no single national documented-stage list found.

attributes.note: Dates for a stage appear on BLM project pages (e.g. ROD 12/4/2024) and BOEM project pages (COP approval 2023-11-17); EIA and the ORES list give none.
attributes.gap_note: BLM/DMM document tables with release and filing dates load by script and were not retrieved; EIA gives only planned operation month/year, not a stage date.

sources.name: Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory (Form EIA-860M) - Planned and Canceled or Postponed sheets
sources.format: XLSX workbook (sheets Operating, Planned, Retired, Canceled or Postponed and Puerto Rico variants)
sources.license: Public domain (EIA reuse page: government publications are in the public domain)
sources.summary: Monthly XLSX with capacity, coordinates, entity and survey status. The September 2026 Planned sheet had 77 wind generator rows across 71 plants. Seventeen rows had code L.
sources.coverage_note: National, 1 MW+ plants reported to or researched by EIA; status is coarse and there is no stage date or developer field.
caveats: Status is an EIA survey code, not a permit record
Canceled or Postponed sheet has no reason or date

problems: Landing page lists October, November and December 2026 XLS links, but those URLs redirect to /electricity/ and return HTML (55,942 bytes) instead of a workbook; the latest downloadable month was September 2026.

example.example_request: curl -sL -o september_generator2026.xlsx 'https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/archive/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx' ; open sheet 'Planned' (header on row 3) and keep rows where 'Energy Source Code' = 'WND'
example.example_result: Entity Name 'Orsted Wind Power North America LLC'; Plant Name 'Revolution Wind'; RI, Washington; 715 MW; 'Offshore Wind Turbine'; Status '(V) Under construction, more than 50 percent complete'; planned operation 11/2026; lat 41.15217, lon -71.07783.

sources.name: BLM National NEPA Register (ePlanning), Renewable Energy program
sources.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Land Management (Department of the Interior)
sources.format: HTML portal pages; JSON returned by the portal's own POST /searchresults/ endpoint (undocumented)
sources.summary: BLM's NEPA Register lists renewable-energy NEPA actions on federal land (485 rows; 32 wind-named); project pages give applicant, county and decision/ROD dates.
sources.coverage_note: Federal onshore actions only; wind is found by name; MW is text only; coordinates on 15 of 32 wind-named rows.
caveats: 'Completed' is the NEPA state, not an approval

problems: No API documentation found for /searchresults/; it is the endpoint the public search page calls.
Document list tables and 'Last Updated' do not appear in the static HTML.

example.example_result: Count call (get_total_count=true): recordsFiltered 485. Row: DOI-BLM-ID-T030-2021-0015-EIS, 'Lava Ridge Wind Project', 'Completed - Completed', EIS, Shoshone Field Office; its project page gives Applicant 'Magic Valley Energy, LLC', Decision Date 12/4/2024.

sources.name: BOEM Offshore Renewable Activities project pages and ArcGIS layers (lease and proposed project phase areas)
sources.publisher: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM), U.S. Department of the Interior
sources.format: HTML project pages; ArcGIS REST FeatureServer (JSON)
sources.license: Public domain (BOEM copyright page: materials produced by federal agencies are in the public domain)
sources.summary: BOEM project pages carry dated approvals and the phase-area ArcGIS layer lists 21 offshore wind project areas with lease number and developer; no MW or stage field.
sources.coverage_note: Offshore only; MW and stage dates come from page text; lease layer is block-level.
caveats: Lease or lease area is not a permit
BOEM and EIA capacities differ for Revolution Wind

problems: BOEM says downloadable files for project component layers are available only through ArcGIS Online services.

example.example_result: {'LEASE_NUMBER':'OCS-A 0486','PROJECT_NAME':'Revolution Wind','DEVELOPER_NAME':'Revolution Wind LLC','AREA_ACRES':82730.88}; returnCountOnly on the layer gives 21. Lease layer OCS-A 0486: COMPANY 'Revolution Wind, LLC', LEASE_DATE '10/01/2013'.

sources.name: ORES major renewable energy facility permit applications (with DMM case pages)
sources.publisher: New York State Department of Public Service, Office of Renewable Energy Siting and Electric Transmission (ORES)
sources.format: HTML tables by application stage; DMM case pages (HTML, script-loaded filing lists)
sources.summary: New York's ORES publishes applications by stage with applicant, MW and towns in the text; 14 of 52 rows mention wind (10 permitted).
sources.coverage_note: One state only; no stage date column; DMM case pages hold dated filings.
caveats: Project name does not prove technology (Bull Run Wind is described as solar)

problems: DMM filing lists load by script, so filing dates were not retrieved.

example.example_result: Permitted row 21-00026 'Heritage Wind': 'Heritage Wind, LLC has received a Permit ... for construction of a 184.8 megawatt (MW) Wind Electric Generating Facility located in the Town of Barre, Orleans County'. DMM 23-02973: NY NORTH COUNTRY, LLC, 360-Megawatt Wind Energy Facility, Franklin and Clinton counties; 764 filed documents.

if_unstructured.summary: Stage dates, applicants and approvals sit in agency project pages and documents, not in the national list. Build the list from EIA-860M, then confirm each project in the agency record that has jurisdiction.

local_terms.meaning: BLM public list of NEPA projects (EA, EIS, CE, DNA) and their decision documents
Federal decision document after an EIS; the stage a NEPA 'Completed' status usually refers to
BOEM-reviewed plan whose approval authorises offshore wind construction
Start of a federal EIS process or a New York ORES filing; not an approval
New York siting permit for major renewable energy facilities issued by ORES
EIA-860M term for a proposed unit, with status codes L, T, P, U, V, TS
BOEM commercial wind lease number on the outer continental shelf
Replacing turbines at an existing wind farm; may be listed as a project without being new capacity

provenance.note: Minutes are researcher estimates. Counts describe documented passes, not publication approval. Missing history or effort is not reconstructed.
